confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from an RBA search result. It showed 0.6720 USD per AUD for 18 Nov 2026. I did not open the RBA page myself. Food and coffee anchors are based on one aggregated search of crowd-sourced cost-of-living sites. Those sites gave a cappuccino of about $2.8-3.2, a beer of about $3-3.9, an inexpensive meal of about $7-9, and a mid-range meal for two of about $54-56. Cocktail and wine are set from the local relationship to beer, not from direct price data. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Arica as a beach and border city, and I did not search for them. Prices may shift in the July 2026 season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized northern Chilean cities such as Iquique and Antofagasta. Arica is somewhat cheaper than Santiago.
